invariants: live/final artifacts use production configuration; fixture flag prohibited
native_prepare exit does not prove UI acceptance
completion state lives only in the append-only completion ledger, never in this manifest
effective_features: Capture exact Cargo/Tauri effective features/defaults from each build; requested list alone is not proof

reviewer.executable: codex (resolved absolute path, version and SHA-256 recorded per attempt; flags verified against its --help)

preferred_transport.requires: reviewer-authored route-ready.json matching a fresh handshake request ID
preferred_transport.note: queue exit status is submission only; the verdict file is the only completion signal

fallback_transport.stdin: controller-rendered transport message plus packet path; never reviewer text

reviewer.freeze: source, dependency, build-flag and evidence fingerprints are recomputed after the verdict arrives; any change fails the attempt
reviewer.expiry: switching transport or retrying creates a new attempt ID and writes expired.json into the prior attempt; verdicts for expired attempts are rejected

shared_lifecycle_contract: C01 creates the allowlist after exact consumed lock and script review. Absent/unknown hashes fail closed. No root prepare/prebuild or Git hook scripts; no automatic lifecycle execution.
shared_source_requirement: Run shared_source_commands at C01/C05/C06 and every chunk changing Academy consumed bytes/revision. C05/C06 extend vitest.presentation.config.ts to learner export and both consumer regressions.

environment_contract.default: clear inherited environment; reject undeclared overrides; never read .env files

build_values.PATH: selected preflight tool directories only, fingerprinted in run manifest

environment_contract.synthetic_fixture_values: C01 approved versioned test-environment manifest only; record nonsecret values/hash; no real Clerk/IdP/tenant credentials
environment_contract.review_auth: actual Codex authenticated CLI profile (CODEX_HOME auth only for the fresh fallback, user config ignored); never inherit application secrets or record credential values
environment_contract.signing_and_live: C25/C26 private execution manifests provide explicitly scoped secret inputs; public evidence records names/source references, never values
environment_contract.enforcement: xtask records command cwd, executable/version/hash, resolved nonsecret env and private-input references; missing required env or unexpected .env is a failed check
